  walk.length = teleport.length →
    BucketMath.Vec.sum walk = 1 →
      BucketMath.Vec.sum teleport = 1 →
        BucketMath.Vec.sum (BucketMath.Vec.add (BucketMath.Vec.smul d walk) (BucketMath.Vec.smul (1 - d) teleport)) = 1

        BucketMath.Vec.dot (BucketMath.Vec.smul (BucketMath.Vec.dot x v) v)
            (BucketMath.Vec.smul (BucketMath.Vec.dot x v) v) +
          BucketMath.Vec.dot (BucketMath.Vec.sub x (BucketMath.Vec.smul (BucketMath.Vec.dot x v) v))

    BucketMath.Learning.Enumerates edge known target order →

        BucketMath.Learning.Path edge known order ∧
          BucketMath.Learning.After known order target ∧
            ∀ (steps : List α),
              BucketMath.Learning.Path edge known steps →

      BucketMath.Learning.Earlier edge known order →
        BucketMath.Learning.Path edge known order ∧
          BucketMath.Learning.After known order target ∧
            ∀ (steps : List α),

name: BucketMath.Marketing.credit_conserves
type:
∀ (credits : List Nat → List Rat),
  (∀ (p : List Nat), p ≠ [] → BucketMath.Vec.sum (credits p) = 1) →
    ∀ (paths : List (List Nat)),
      (∀ (p : List Nat), p ∈ paths → p ≠ []) → BucketMath.Marketing.totalCredit credits paths = ↑paths.length

name: BucketMath.Marketing.ctr
type: Rat → Rat → Option Rat

name: BucketMath.Marketing.ctr_le_one
type:
∀ {clicks impressions x : Rat},
  0 ≤ clicks → clicks ≤ impressions → BucketMath.Marketing.ctr clicks impressions = some x → x ≤ 1

name: BucketMath.Marketing.lastTouchCredits
type: List Nat → List Rat

name: BucketMath.Marketing.last_touch_conserves
type:
∀ (paths : List (List Nat)),

    BucketMath.Marketing.totalCredit BucketMath.Marketing.lastTouchCredits paths = ↑paths.length

name: BucketMath.Marketing.last_touch_path_one
type: ∀ {path : List Nat}, path ≠ [] → BucketMath.Vec.sum (BucketMath.Marketing.lastTouchCredits path) = 1

name: BucketMath.Marketing.linear_conserves

∀ (paths : List (List Nat)),

    BucketMath.Marketing.totalCredit BucketMath.Marketing.linearCredits paths = ↑paths.length

name: BucketMath.Marketing.linear_path_one
type: ∀ {path : List Nat}, path ≠ [] → BucketMath.Vec.sum (BucketMath.Marketing.linearCredits path) = 1

name: BucketMath.Marketing.ltvHist
type: Rat → Rat → Option Rat

name: BucketMath.Marketing.mix_sum_one
type: ∀ {xs : List Rat}, BucketMath.Vec.sum xs ≠ 0 → BucketMath.Vec.sum (BucketMath.Marketing.shares xs) = 1

name: BucketMath.Marketing.ratio
type: Rat → Rat → Option Rat

name: BucketMath.Marketing.ratio_le_one
type: ∀ {num den x : Rat}, 0 ≤ num → num ≤ den → BucketMath.Marketing.ratio num den = some x → x ≤ 1

name: BucketMath.Marketing.ratio_mul
type: ∀ {num den x : Rat}, BucketMath.Marketing.ratio num den = some x → x * den = num

name: BucketMath.Marketing.retention

name: BucketMath.Marketing.retention_le_one
type: ∀ {active cohort x : Rat}, 0 ≤ active → active ≤ cohort → BucketMath.Marketing.retention active cohort = some x → x ≤ 1

name: BucketMath.Marketing.roas_ge_one_iff
type:
∀ {revenue spend : Rat},
  0 < spend → BucketMath.Marketing.roas revenue spend = some (revenue / spend) ∧ (1 ≤ revenue / spend ↔ spend ≤ revenue)

name: BucketMath.Marketing.sum_map_div
type: ∀ (xs : List Rat) (t : Rat), BucketMath.Vec.sum (List.map (fun x => x / t) xs) = BucketMath.Vec.sum xs / t

name: BucketMath.Marketing.sum_replicate
type: ∀ (n : Nat) (c : Rat), BucketMath.Vec.sum (List.replicate n c) = ↑n * c

name: BucketMath.Markets.classify
type: Int → BucketMath.Markets.Industry → BucketMath.Markets.Regime

name: BucketMath.Markets.classify_above_iff
type:
∀ (band : Int) (i : BucketMath.Markets.Industry),
  BucketMath.Markets.classify band i = BucketMath.Markets.Regime.above ↔ band < BucketMath.Markets.spread i

name: BucketMath.Markets.classify_efficient_iff
type:
∀ (band : Int) (i : BucketMath.Markets.Industry),
  BucketMath.Markets.classify band i = BucketMath.Markets.Regime.efficient ↔
    -band ≤ BucketMath.Markets.spread i ∧ BucketMath.Markets.spread i ≤ band

name: BucketMath.Markets.compete
type: Int → Nat → BucketMath.Markets.Industry → BucketMath.Markets.Industry

name: BucketMath.Markets.compete_bound
type:
∀ (step : Int) (n : Nat) (i : BucketMath.Markets.Industry),
  BucketMath.Markets.spread (BucketMath.Markets.compete step n i) ≤ max 0 (BucketMath.Markets.spread i - ↑n * step)

name: BucketMath.Markets.compete_reaches_efficiency
type:
∀ (step : Int) (i : BucketMath.Markets.Industry) (n : Nat),
  BucketMath.Markets.spread i ≤ ↑n * step → BucketMath.Markets.spread (BucketMath.Markets.compete step n i) ≤ 0

name: BucketMath.Markets.efficient_spread_bounded
type:
∀ (band : Int) (i : BucketMath.Markets.Industry),
  BucketMath.Markets.classify band i = BucketMath.Markets.Regime.efficient →
    -band ≤ BucketMath.Markets.spread i ∧ BucketMath.Markets.spread i ≤ band

name: BucketMath.Markets.eva_pos_iff
type: ∀ (i : BucketMath.Markets.Industry), 0 < i.capital → (0 < BucketMath.Markets.eva i ↔ 0 < BucketMath.Markets.spread i)

name: BucketMath.Markets.eva_zero_iff
type: ∀ (i : BucketMath.Markets.Industry), 0 < i.capital → (BucketMath.Markets.eva i = 0 ↔ BucketMath.Markets.spread i = 0)

name: BucketMath.Markets.excess
type: Int → Int → Int

name: BucketMath.Markets.excess_zero_iff
type: ∀ (r bench : Int), BucketMath.Markets.excess r bench = 0 ↔ r = bench

name: BucketMath.Markets.spread
type: BucketMath.Markets.Industry → Int

name: BucketMath.Markets.spread_entry
type:
∀ (step : Int) (i : BucketMath.Markets.Industry),
  BucketMath.Markets.spread (BucketMath.Markets.entry step i) = BucketMath.Markets.spread i - step

name: BucketMath.Markets.zero_spread_is_efficient
type:
∀ (band : Int),
  0 ≤ band →
    ∀ (i : BucketMath.Markets.Industry),
      BucketMath.Markets.spread i = 0 → BucketMath.Markets.classify band i = BucketMath.Markets.Regime.efficient

name: BucketMath.Project.Orthonormal
type: List (List Rat) → Prop

name: BucketMath.Project.dot_add_left
type:
∀ (a b c : List Rat),
  a.length = b.length → BucketMath.Vec.dot (BucketMath.Vec.add a b) c = BucketMath.Vec.dot a c + BucketMath.Vec.dot b c

name: BucketMath.Project.dot_basis_project
type:
∀ (x v : List Rat) (vs : List (List Rat)),
  (∀ (u : List Rat), u ∈ vs → u.length = x.length) →
    BucketMath.Project.Orthonormal vs →
      vs.Nodup → v ∈ vs → BucketMath.Vec.dot v (BucketMath.Project.project vs x) = BucketMath.Vec.dot x v

name: BucketMath.Project.dot_project_left
type:
∀ (x w : List Rat) (vs : List (List Rat)),
  (∀ (v : List Rat), v ∈ vs → v.length = x.length) →
    BucketMath.Vec.dot (BucketMath.Project.project vs x) w =
      BucketMath.Vec.sum (List.map (fun v => BucketMath.Vec.dot x v * BucketMath.Vec.dot v w) vs)

name: BucketMath.Project.dot_zeros
type: ∀ (x w : List Rat), BucketMath.Vec.dot (List.map (fun x => 0) x) w = 0

name: BucketMath.Project.length_add
type: ∀ (a b : List Rat), a.length = b.length → (BucketMath.Vec.add a b).length = a.length

name: BucketMath.Project.length_project
type:
∀ (x : List Rat) (vs : List (List Rat)),
  (∀ (v : List Rat), v ∈ vs → v.length = x.length) → (BucketMath.Project.project vs x).length = x.length

name: BucketMath.Project.project
type: List (List Rat) → List Rat → List Rat

name: BucketMath.Project.pythagoras_orthonormal
type:
∀ (x : List Rat) (vs : List (List Rat)),
  (∀ (v : List Rat), v ∈ vs → v.length = x.length) →
    BucketMath.Project.Orthonormal vs →
      vs.Nodup →
        BucketMath.Vec.dot x x =
          BucketMath.Vec.dot (BucketMath.Project.project vs x) (BucketMath.Project.project vs x) +
            BucketMath.Vec.dot (BucketMath.Vec.sub x (BucketMath.Project.project vs x))
              (BucketMath.Vec.sub x (BucketMath.Project.project vs x))

name: BucketMath.Project.sum_delta
type:
∀ (f : List Rat → Rat) (v : List Rat) (us : List (List Rat)),
  v ∈ us → us.Nodup → BucketMath.Vec.sum (List.map (fun u => f u * if u = v then 1 else 0) us) = f v

name: BucketMath.Project.sum_delta_absent
type:
∀ (f : List Rat → Rat) (v : List Rat) (us : List (List Rat)),
  ¬v ∈ us → BucketMath.Vec.sum (List.map (fun u => f u * if u = v then 1 else 0) us) = 0

name: BucketMath.Ranking.ordered_perm_unique

∀ {l₁ l₂ : List BucketMath.Ranking.Result},

name: BucketMath.Ranking.rank_unique

∀ (l out : List BucketMath.Ranking.Result),
  BucketMath.Ranking.UniqueIds l → out.Perm l → BucketMath.Ranking.Ordered out → out = BucketMath.Ranking.rank l

name: BucketMath.Vec.dot_smul_left

name: BucketMath.Vec.dot_smul_right
type: ∀ (c : Rat) (a b : List Rat), BucketMath.Vec.dot a (BucketMath.Vec.smul c b) = c * BucketMath.Vec.dot a b

name: BucketMath.Vec.dot_sub_left

∀ (a b c : List Rat),
  a.length = b.length → BucketMath.Vec.dot (BucketMath.Vec.sub a b) c = BucketMath.Vec.dot a c - BucketMath.Vec.dot b c

name: BucketMath.Vec.dot_sub_right

∀ (a b c : List Rat),
  b.length = c.length → BucketMath.Vec.dot a (BucketMath.Vec.sub b c) = BucketMath.Vec.dot a b - BucketMath.Vec.dot a c

name: BucketMath.Vec.sum_smul

name: BucketMath.Vec.sum_sub_const
